stem: Affected plants are all from one propagation batch while adjacent older plants under the same room conditions are normal. How should this pattern influence the differential?
choices: Increase attention to batch-specific history, roots, propagation stress or source health while retaining shared-environment alternatives until tested.
Prove the room environment is irrelevant.
rationale: Cohort patterns can prioritize batch-specific hypotheses but do not prove a cause or exclude shared factors.
